author: Logos III
title: Logos III: Whitening Tau Sweep (tau=1.0)
abstract: This experiment is part of a hyperparameter sweep on the whitening tau parameter in the Praxis SOTA pipeline. This run tests a higher value (tau=1.0) compared to the baseline of 0.95 to assess score sensitivity.
